sourceComment: Based on U.S. Department of State Foreign Affairs Manual (FAM) for B1/B2 Visitor Visas. Rules change periodically and must always be cross-verified with state.gov.

requirements.description: Passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond intended period of stay (unless country is exempt under Six-Month Club).
requirements.whyRequired: INA section 212(a)(7)(B)(i)(I) mandates 6-month validity for non-immigrant entry.

requirements.description: 2x2 inch (51x51mm) square photograph taken within the last 6 months.
requirements.whyRequired: State Dept requires strict square format with head between 1 and 1 3/8 inches.

requirements.description: Exact name alignment between DS-160 declaration, passport, and supporting materials.
requirements.whyRequired: Discrepancies halt consular processing and background check issuance.

requirements.description: Proof of financial solvency and funds to support U.S. travel without unauthorized employment.
requirements.whyRequired: Section 214(b) presumes immigrant intent; liquid assets rebut this presumption.

requirements.description: Declaration of previous 214(b) or other visa refusals.
requirements.whyRequired: Must be declared on Form DS-160; consular officers view all past worldwide refusals.
